utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s shaping up well — people are really turning out for the repair drive. I’ll stop by after lunch and see if they need any extra hands, tools, or snacks.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate you keeping it low-key for now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep it quiet and just check in after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—let’s check the list now, then I’ll sort my things by 10 and head over with the first load.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—let’s go through it now and make sure everything’s ready before you head out at 10.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great—let’s go through the list now and make sure I’m set for 10.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll be there a little later to help sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Dane — I’ll keep the donations organized and have my list ready when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, see you a little later — I’ll jump in and help get everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan around the block so everyone hears about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates and pass them along if I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You bet — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and make sure the plan gets around.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the donation sorting and then check which homes need the most urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Rey — thank you. Let’s start with the donations, then we’ll make a quick list of the most urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — just point me to the donations, and I’ll start sorting right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can send a little later today, quietly. Please keep my name out of it for now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — what’s the first repair you want me to look at?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Let’s start with the loose front step, if that’s still on the list. I can send the small amount later today, quietly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can grab the gloves and basic tools first. Point me to the next gap when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’m checking the supplies now and will make a quick missing-items list for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — just send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll fill the next gap.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got you—right now I’m keeping track of locations for the repair drive, so if you see anything that needs sorting, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Opal — I’ll keep sending folks and anything needing sorting your way for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye on the locations and sort what comes in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to spread the word, but I still don’t have the day and time yet—if you’ve got it, send it over and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, we still don’t have the day and time for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Right, I still don’t have the day and time yet—once you send it over, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira—please check back when you have the latest drop-off details, and I’ll wait before I act.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I will — I’m still out running errands, but I’ll check back for the latest drop-off details as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira—I’ll hold off until you’ve got the drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still at 14 Maple, and I haven’t set anything out yet. Sorry, I almost missed this again.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worries — I’ve got 14 Maple noted, and once you set things out, I’ll keep track of it all for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll set something out soon if I find a few more things. Appreciate you keeping track.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word, and let me know if you need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — that really helps. I’ll keep an eye out for anyone else who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Glad to help, Noah — I’ll keep spreading the word and can still help with a few fixes if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, but I’ll check back and see if I can make it by the repair drive later.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No rush—if you can make it, swing by whenever you’re free. I’m happy to keep sharing the word so folks know it’s still going strong.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules—I appreciate it. I’ll see how errands go and stop by if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring a hammer, a cordless drill, a tape measure, and a set of screwdrivers. If you think of anything else, just let me know before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — that covers the basics. Do you know the drop-off time and where we should bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I don’t have the drop-off time yet, but I can bring the tools to the school entrance unless you hear otherwise. If you get the exact time, let me know and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can do that, Tess — I’ll help spread the word and sort donations when they come in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, wonderful — if you can start at the community hall around 4, that’d be a big help. I’ll swing by later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll be at the community hall around 4 and help wherever I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — I’ll bring my toolbox and help with the loose fence boards.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll be there soon and can help with anything else small that comes up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that would really help. If you can keep folks informed, I’ll make sure we’ve got a clear parking setup.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan around the block so everyone hears about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that should help a lot. I’m still a little worried about parking, but if we keep the timing clear, we should be okay.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can take a look at the squeaky porch door first. Do you want me to oil it now or should I wait for you?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Go ahead and oil it now, Mina — that’d be a big help. I’ll try to remember to bring the other repair stuff by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll oil the porch door now, and I’ll look for your repair stuff on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let everyone know about the repair drive right away, and I’ll point anyone with stuff to you, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. That really helps a lot—just send folks my way if they need repairs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll spread the word and send anyone with repairs straight your way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m on it — I’ll check our supplies and jot down anything we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll swing by a little later and help sort through it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Dane — I’ll have everything laid out and a short list ready when you come by.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — just keep me posted, and I’ll work around pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Faye — I’ll confirm the time as soon as it’s set and let you know which tools I’m bringing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Gus — I’ll keep my schedule flexible and plan around pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks for the reminder — tools, spare parts, and something to sort everything. I can help gather a few things if you tell me what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — I’m still tracking a few tools and spare parts, and I’m trying to keep the list neat so we don’t miss anything. I’m also a little worried about parking and timing, so organization really helps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course — I can help keep an eye on the list and see if I can round up any tools or spare parts. If you want, I can also help think through the parking and timing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that’ll make a big difference. Let’s keep the table by the door, and I’ll make sure the sign-up sheet is ready for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll stay by the door and help folks find the sign-up sheet. Let’s make it easy and welcoming for everyone coming in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — I’ll have the sheet and pens ready by the door, and we can welcome everyone as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — that’d be great. If you spot the sign-up, could you tell me whether they still need tools, gloves, or volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’ll check for the sign-up and see whether they still need tools, gloves, or volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’d really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on today. I’ll bring my toolbox and help with the fence boards.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming — what time should we expect you?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
